arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp/t && head -2 t8.jsonl | cut -c1-120; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, re
lines=[]
for l in open('/app/tmp/t/t8.jsonl'):
    l=l.strip()
    l=l.replace(",[,\"state\"","")
    d=json.loads(l)
    d["events"]=[x for x in d["events"] if x]
    lines.append(json.dumps(d))
open('/app/tmp/t/t8.jsonl','w').write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
print("ok")
EOF
